clip: Budots Dance Video (Commons), the soundtrack from 8.8 s to 58.2 s (49 s), a steady electronic track

music.note: the clip's video fixture meta says 143.55 (librosa start-tempo estimate); the tracked beats and an ffmpeg look at the intervals give 140.0

author: Sherwin Tuna (DJ Love)
description: The beat grid thoremin's own tracker (trackSongGrid, ictus/flux-acf, defaults, 22.05 kHz mono) makes of a REAL song: 115 beats, interval sd 2.1 % of the period, single intervals 0.90 to 1.11 of it. It is the tracker's output, not ground truth. The audio is not kept (deletable; the source URL is the way back). Used to measure what a real song's beat jitter leaves in the pace controller (#346 item 4).
